title: From the Loss Landscape to Diverse Feature Learning in Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2608.28948v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Over the course of the last decade, neural networks have grown from an academic curiosity to moving the markets of nations. Despite this explosion in both research and deployment, relatively little is understood about how they achieve the solutions they do. This is both scientifically relevant, and pressing for society. When neural networks make decisions across self-driving, construction, law, hiring and health, there have been and will continue to be unintended consequences.   However, attempting to generalize the failures of the largest and most important production systems makes for a very difficult task. Yet signs of these failures exist at all scales of neural networks, so we should be able to study a much more tractable setting. All neural networks must undergo an optimization process, called training, to be useful. translated_title: 从损失景观到神经网络中的多样化特征学习
translated_abstract: 在过去十年中，神经网络已从学术界的好奇事物成长为能够影响国家市场的技术。尽管在研究和部署方面都出现了爆炸式增长，但人们对其如何获得所得到的解决方案仍知之甚少。这既具有科学意义，也对社会具有紧迫性。当神经网络在自动驾驶、建筑、法律、招聘和医疗等领域做出决策时，已经产生并将继续产生意想不到的后果。然而，试图归纳那些最大且最重要的生产系统的失败原因是一项非常困难的任务。但这些失败的迹象存在于所有规模的神经网络中，因此我们应该能够在一个更容易处理的研究环境中加以研究。所有神经网络都必须经历一个称为训练的优化过程才能发挥作用。在很大程度上，理解神经网络就是理解其优化过程：通过何种过程和机制……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过损失景观的视角研究神经网络的优化过程，旨在揭示网络如何学习多样化的特征，从而为在更易处理的规模上理解和预测神经网络的失败机制提供理论基础。
en_tdlr: This paper investigates neural network optimization through the lens of the loss landscape to understand how networks learn diverse features, providing a more tractable setting for understanding and predicting neural network failures.
